meta.description: Rolls the margin of a cap in under it, every ray bends down towards its tip.

cap.description: The paths of the cap node: the rays of the caps and their stipes

amount.description: How far a ray turns in under the cap, 0 = not at all, 1 = half a turn. A value alone rolls the outer third of the cap, like a button at 1. Connect a curve to set the turn from the centre (alpha 0) to the margin (alpha 1). Read once for every cap, so a random node gives every mushroom its own curl.
